query: Startup band ho raha hai aur founder bol raha hai ki FNF settlement ke paise nahi bache, investors ke aane par denge.

model_output.summary: Startup band hone par founder ka FNF (Full and Final) settlement ke paise rokna aur investors ka wait karne ko kehna galat hai. Payment of Wages Act ke anusar, jab bhi kisi employee ki naukri khatam ki jati hai, toh uske earned wages (kamaye gaye paise) naukri khatam hone ke do working dinon ke andar milne chahiye.
facts_extracted: Founder FNF settlement ke paise dene se mana kar raha hai
Founder ka kehna hai ki investor aane ke baad paise diye jayenge

options.title: Legal Notice Bhejein
options.description: Aap apne employer ya startup ko ek formal legal notice bhej sakte hain jisme FNF settlement ke paise 2 din ke andar dene ki maang ki jaye.
pros: Court jane se pehle mamla sulajh sakta hai
cons: Employer respond na kare toh agla kadam uthana padega

options.title: Lok Adalat ka Sahayata Lein
options.description: Aap District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) ke zariye Lok Adalat mein apna mamla rakh sakte hain jahan bina court fee ke aapas mein raazinama ya settlement kiya ja sakta hai.
pros: Faisla final aur jaldi ho sakta hai
cons: Dono pakshon ki raazi hona zaroori hai

citations.relevance: Yeh section kehta hai ki jab employer dwara naukri khatam ki jati hai, toh earned wages ko do working din ke andar dena anivarya hai.
Yeh tay karta hai ki employer hi zemedar hai ki employees ko sabhi wages time par milein.
Wages bina kisi unauthorized deduction ke diye jane chahiye.
Pre-litigation disputes ko sulajhane ke liye Lok Adalat organize karne ki kshamta deta hai.

model_output.lawyer_reason: Startup ke band hone aur fund na hone ki sthiti mein ek advocate ya DLSA (Helpline 15100) ki madad se legal notice bhejna aur settlement karwana behtar rahega.
